card.name: Linking words before PCI procedure
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, before, of, after, during that come just before an expected mention of PCI, balloon inflation, or stenting. Seen in dosing instructions for anticoagulants and antiplatelets around coronary procedures.

modes.label: Timing word before PCI
modes.description: Preposition or time word placed right before the procedure name in dosing timing.
modes.example: Initiate the bolus infusion prior<< to>> PCI.

modes.label: Procedure-related word before stent or balloon
modes.description: Word that sets up a coronary stent or balloon term next.
modes.example: should not be recommended for patients receiving<< coronary>> stents.

card.writes: Boosts catheter-procedure words such as PCI, cath, balloon, stent and intervention as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a heart catheter procedure like PCI is named.
